correctness.rationale: Over a fixed labelled poset, one-point extensions are precisely disjoint ideal/filter pairs L,U with all L<U. In Q=A⊕B there are 2^(a+b) middle placements and 2^a-1 and 2^b-1 upper/lower placements. Removing u<v permits two previously forbidden placements and disallows 2^(a+b-2) formerly permitted u<x<v placements. Thus c(Q)=2^(a+b)+2^a+2^b-2, c(P)=3·2^(a+b-2)+2^a+2^b and the difference=2^(a+b-2)-2 for a,b>=1, including the negative a=b=1 case. Independently reconstructed an exhaustive generator of transitively closed strict labelled posets and tested all n<=4 and all legal directed added comparabilities, obtaining labelled poset counts (1,3,19,219), 1044 additions at n=4, 120 positive changes, none for n<=3. The last six-isomorphism-class multiplicity breakdown was reported by supplied verifier but was not separately canonicalized in this run.
